title: torp CI pipeline
about: What torp's daily GitHub Actions run does, in order, and how long each part takes: it recomputes the player and team ratings from the data torpdata has just released, publishes them, then builds and publishes the AFL match predictions. When it finishes it starts torpdata's Build blog data run, which puts the results on the site's data store. This guide lives in .github/pipeline/ because the repo's docs/ folder is ignored by git (it holds the pkgdown website build).

pipelines.name: Daily ratings and predictions
pipelines.about: Two jobs one after the other: compute-ratings, then build-predictions. Each installs R first. Runs counted are successful ones on the main branch where both jobs succeeded and the run took over 10 minutes. The workflow on the dev branch has since gained an off-season gate job (offseason-gate) that skips scheduled runs when no match is near; it is listed below as optional because the runs counted here came from main, before it.
pipelines.triggers: In practice the four weekly pre-game schedule runs, so predictions use the published team lists: Thursday and Friday at 5pm and Saturday and Sunday at 11am, Sydney summer time; all five runs counted here were schedule runs. Also started by torpdata's Daily Data Release, which sends the ratings-trigger event after a real data release (within hours of a match ending), and by hand with Run workflow (inputs: force, week_override, seasons). When build-predictions succeeds it sends the blog-trigger event to torpdata, which starts torpdata's Build blog data run (see torpdata's guide). The two runs are not stitched together here.

steps.name: Rebuild stat ratings
steps.about: Runs three scripts in data-raw/06-stat-ratings/: collects every player's per-match stats and adjusts them for the opponent, estimates each player's stat ratings round by round, and uploads the stat ratings to the torpdata release (skipped when torpdata reports a team-only release)

stage_notes.Rebuild stat ratings, in order: Each stage runs from its header line to the next one; the last runs to the end of the step.
stage_notes.Stages of run_ratings_pipeline.R: Each stage runs from its header line to the next one; the last runs to the end of the step. Stage 1 (refresh upstream data) is switched off in this workflow.

stage_about.Loading data: Loads the per-match player stats, rosters, fixtures and lineups from torpdata
stage_about.Preparing stat rating data: Builds one table of every player's stats for every match
stage_about.Opponent-adjusting per-game stats: Adjusts each game's stats for the opponent, using each player's rolling past profile
stage_about.Loading stat rating data: Reloads the prepared table for the rating step
stage_about.Estimating stat ratings by round: Estimates every player's stat ratings round by round
stage_about.Combining results: Joins the rounds' results into one table
stage_about.Loading computed stat ratings: Reloads the combined ratings for export
stage_about.Exporting to torpdata: Uploads the stat ratings to the player_stat_ratings-data release
stage_about.Stage 2: Build Player Game Data: Builds each player's per-match data from play-by-play, player stats and teams, and releases it
stage_about.Stage 3: Compute EPR Ratings: Computes the EPR ratings for the current season and releases them
stage_about.Stage 4: Compute Team Ratings: Computes the team ratings from the player ratings and releases them
stage_about.Stage 5: Player Game & Season Ratings: Builds the player game and player season ratings
stage_about.Stage 6: Compute & Release PSR: Computes PSR (player stat ratings) and releases it
stage_about.Stage 7: Compute & Release AFLW PSR: The same for the women's competition (AFLW); a failure here is reported but does not stop the run

Stages of the match predictions pipeline.name: Training GAM models on completed matches

stage_notes.Stages of the match predictions pipeline: Each stage runs from its header line to the next one; the last runs to the end of the step.

stage_about.Loading data: Loads the stadium list, expected goals, fixtures, results, teams and TORP ratings from torpdata, and checks them
stage_about.Building fixture features: Builds the fixture table from the fixture list
stage_about.Loading PSR: Computes PSR (player stat ratings) from the released player stat ratings
stage_about.Processing lineups: Loads the team xRAPM snapshot and builds each team's rating from its lineup
stage_about.Computing features: Builds each match's features from the two teams' ratings and the ground
stage_about.Building model dataset: Joins everything into one table for the models
stage_about.Training GAM models on completed matches: Trains the GAM match models on matches already played
stage_about.Generating predictions: Predicts the coming round (matches already started keep their locked prediction)
stage_about.Validating predictions: Checks the predictions before they are published
stage_about.Uploading predictions: Uploads the predictions to the torpdata releases
